title: Grade 4 HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — Mock Exam #2

pages.quiz:
HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — MOCK EXAM #2
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 90 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 80
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. What does the Sanskrit word Panch mean in Panch Mahabhoot? (1 mark)
   A. Seven
   B. Five
   C. Three
   D. Ten

2. Which Sanskrit word means water? (1 mark)
   A. Agni
   B. Prithvi
   C. Jal
   D. Vayu

3. What should you do when you join a religious activity of another faith? (1 mark)
   A. Refuse to sit
   B. Make noise
   C. Listen carefully and behave politely
   D. Laugh at it

4. Which element is called Vayu? (1 mark)
   A. Fire
   B. Air
   C. Earth
   D. Space

5. What does the story of the swan teach us? (1 mark)
   A. To ignore suffering
   B. To be proud
   C. To hunt for fun
   D. To be kind to animals and help the hurt

6. Whom did Guru Ram Das Ji serve before becoming Guru? (1 mark)
   A. Guru Arjan Dev Ji
   B. Guru Nanak
   C. Guru Gobind Singh Ji
   D. Guru Amar Das Ji

7. Which faith does the Dhammapada belong to? (1 mark)
   A. Jainism
   B. Hinduism
   C. Sikhism
   D. Buddhism

8. Who asked that Bharat be made king? (1 mark)
   A. Queen Kaikeyi
   B. Sita
   C. Ganga
   D. Mahaprajapati

9. What does the essence of a scripture mean? (1 mark)
   A. Its length
   B. Its price
   C. Its cover
   D. Its most important message

10. What did Bharat place on the throne? (1 mark)
   A. A lamp
   B. Ram's sandals (paduka)
   C. A book
   D. A crown

11. What does the Twameva prayer teach us about God? (1 mark)
   A. God is a stranger
   B. God cares for us like a parent and friend
   C. God is only a king
   D. God is far and angry

12. What is the murti in a Mandir? (1 mark)
   A. A lamp
   B. A book
   C. A seat
   D. A statue of God

13. What is the garbhagriha? (1 mark)
   A. The car park
   B. The inner room where the murti is placed
   C. The gate
   D. The kitchen

14. What is darshan? (1 mark)
   A. Leaving early
   B. Paying fees
   C. Looking at the murti with respect
   D. Running around

15. Which is safe behaviour in a matatu? (1 mark)
   A. Standing in the aisle
   B. Wearing the seat belt
   C. Putting the head out of the window
   D. Distracting the driver

16. What is a parable? (1 mark)
   A. A short story with a lesson
   B. A river
   C. A festival
   D. A kind of prayer

17. What is Bhastrika called in English? (1 mark)
   A. The bellows breath
   B. The moon pose
   C. The hare pose
   D. The shining forehead breath

18. Why do children work in pairs in yoga? (1 mark)
   A. To argue
   B. To copy
   C. To check posture and encourage each other
   D. To race

19. How should the back be in Vajra Asana? (1 mark)
   A. Bent
   B. Round
   C. Twisted
   D. Straight

20. Because God sees all we do, what should we do? (1 mark)
   A. Cheat
   B. Be honest even when alone
   C. Complain
   D. Hide

21. What does Punarjanam mean? (1 mark)
   A. A festival
   B. A river
   C. A prayer
   D. Rebirth

22. What does Param mean in Paramatma? (1 mark)
   A. Quiet
   B. Small
   C. Highest
   D. New

23. What does the Vedic saying say about the truth? (1 mark)
   A. It is only for kings
   B. It has many separate truths
   C. It is one but is called by many names
   D. It is unknown

24. Which is a kind of prayer? (1 mark)
   A. A market
   B. A song of prayer called a bhajan
   C. A race
   D. A school race

25. What is a jagaran or vigil? (1 mark)
   A. Staying awake at night to pray and sing
   B. A race
   C. Eating a big meal
   D. A meal

26. Why do the dates of Maha Shivratri and Paryushan change on the usual calendar? (1 mark)
   A. They follow the market days
   B. They follow the Moon
   C. They follow the shops
   D. They follow the school terms

27. Paryushan Parva is a festival of which faith? (1 mark)
   A. Buddhism
   B. Jainism
   C. Sikhism
   D. Hinduism

28. In which month of the Indian traditional calendar is Maha Shivratri celebrated? (1 mark)
   A. Phalguna
   B. Chaitra
   C. Kartika
   D. Bhadrapada

29. How long is Paryushan in one Jain tradition? (1 mark)
   A. Two days
   B. Eight days
   C. One month
   D. One year

30. Mangal is the Indian name for which planet? (1 mark)
   A. Mars
   B. Venus
   C. Jupiter
   D. Mercury

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
31. Choose one teaching from an Enlightened Being and say how you can follow it at school. (3 marks)

32. Match the days to the heavenly bodies: Ravivaar, Somvaar, Mangalvaar. (3 marks)

33. Compare Vajra Asana and Sasankasana. (5 marks)

34. Write three ways of conserving water in the community. (3 marks)

35. Explain the words Micchami Dukkadam said at Paryushan. (2 marks)

36. Describe the early life of Sri Guru Ram Das Ji. (4 marks)

37. Give four roles of sacred plants. (4 marks)

38. Describe the story of Guru Nanak and Bhai Lalo and its lesson. (4 marks)

39. State three reasons why the Saraswati Vandana is said by students. (3 marks)

40. Draw a timeline from January to December and mark Maha Shivratri, Madaraka Day and Paryushan. (4 marks)

41. Give two benefits of daily prayer. (2 marks)

42. Describe how a child can follow all five principles in one day. (5 marks)

43. What is a Tirthankar? (2 marks)

44. Give three reasons why prayer is a principle of Dharma. (3 marks)

45. Explain what Punarjanam means. (3 marks)
pages.answers:
HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — MOCK EXAM #2 · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. B — Five
   Panch means five, and there are five great elements.

2. C — Jal
   Jal (also Apas) means water.

3. C — Listen carefully and behave politely
   We show respect to all faiths.

4. B — Air
   Vayu means air and wind.

5. D — To be kind to animals and help the hurt
   Siddhartha showed kindness.

6. D — Guru Amar Das Ji
   He served the third Guru with humility.

7. D — Buddhism
   It is a collection of Buddhist verses.

8. A — Queen Kaikeyi
   Kaikeyi reminded the king of two promises.

9. D — Its most important message
   The essence is the main lesson inside.

10. B — Ram's sandals (paduka)
   Bharat ruled in Ram's name.

11. B — God cares for us like a parent and friend
   God is called our mother, father and friend.

12. D — A statue of God
   The murti is a statue or image of God.

13. B — The inner room where the murti is placed
   It is the inner sanctum.

14. C — Looking at the murti with respect
   Darshan is a respectful sight of God.

15. B — Wearing the seat belt
   A seat belt protects you.

16. A — A short story with a lesson
   A parable teaches a moral.

17. A — The bellows breath
   A bellows pumps air into a fire.

18. C — To check posture and encourage each other
   Pairs encourage and help.

19. D — Straight
   A straight back is important.

20. B — Be honest even when alone
   Honesty at all times.

21. D — Rebirth
   Punarjanam is being born again.

22. C — Highest
   Param means highest.

23. C — It is one but is called by many names
   The truth is one, the wise call it by many names.

24. B — A song of prayer called a bhajan
   Bhajans are sung prayers.

25. A — Staying awake at night to pray and sing
   Devotees stay awake.

26. B — They follow the Moon
   The Indian calendar is based on the Moon.

27. B — Jainism
   It is the main Jain festival.

28. A — Phalguna
   Phalguna, in February or March.

29. B — Eight days
   Eight days in one tradition and ten in another.

30. A — Mars
   Mangal is Mars, the red planet.

SECTION B
----
31. (3 marks)
   Answer: Any sensible answer, for example Ahimsa: I will not bully or hurt classmates, and I will care for plants.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the being, 1 mark for the teaching, 1 mark for a clear action.

32. (3 marks)
   Answer: Sun, Moon, Mars.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark each.

33. (5 marks)
   Answer: Vajra Asana is sitting on the heels with a straight back. Sasankasana starts in Vajra Asana and bends forward with the forehead on the mat and arms stretched forward. Both are calm and use steady breathing.
   Working / marking points: 2 marks for each pose and 1 mark for a similarity.

34. (3 marks)
   Answer: Closing taps, mending leaks, collecting rainwater, reusing water on plants, not polluting rivers (any three).
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each sensible way.

35. (2 marks)
   Answer: May any harm I did in thought, word or deed be forgiven.
   Working / marking points: 2 marks for forgiveness.

36. (4 marks)
   Answer: He was born in Lahore with the childhood name Jetha, lost his parents young, helped his family by selling boiled grain, and later served Guru Amar Das Ji.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct point, up to 4.

37. (4 marks)
   Answer: They give oxygen and clean the air; they give shade for rest and prayer; their leaves, fruits and bark are used for food and medicine; their leaves and flowers are used in worship; they remind us to care for life.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct role.

38. (4 marks)
   Answer: Guru Nanak chose to eat at the home of Bhai Lalo, an honest carpenter, instead of Malik Bhago's feast. The lesson is that honest work is the best way to earn.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for Bhai Lalo, 1 mark for choosing his home, 1 mark for honest labour, 1 mark for the lesson.

39. (3 marks)
   Answer: To ask for a clear mind, good speech and love for reading, music and the arts (any three).
   Working / marking points: 1 mark each.

40. (4 marks)
   Answer: A line from January to December with Maha Shivratri in February or March, Madaraka Day on 1 June and Paryushan in August or September.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the line and months, 1 mark for each correct festival.

41. (2 marks)
   Answer: It helps us start the day calmly, teaches discipline, makes us thankful and gives peace of mind (any two).
   Working / marking points: 1 mark each.

42. (5 marks)
   Answer: Morning prayer and Namaste (Prarthana, Paramatma), honest schoolwork (Dharma, Artha), helping a friend (Prani Daya), thinking about the day's good deeds (Punarjanam and karma).
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each principle applied, up to 5.

43. (2 marks)
   Answer: A Jain teacher who shows people the path to freedom, like a guide across a river.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for teacher, 1 mark for showing the path.

44. (3 marks)
   Answer: It makes us thankful, calm and humble, gives courage, and reminds us we are not alone (any three).
   Working / marking points: 1 mark each.

45. (3 marks)
   Answer: Punarjanam is rebirth. The soul does not die but takes a new body until it reaches Moksha.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for rebirth, 1 mark for the soul, 1 mark for Moksha.
